items.question: To what geographical extent and violent form will Kāmākhyā's destructive action reach?
premises: Kāmākhyā continues the violent action described in the preceding verses.
The action is said to extend as far as the Karatoyā river.
The action will produce a great battle.
items.inference: Kāmākhyā's manifestation will culminate in a great battle reaching as far as the Karatoyā river.
uncertainties: Whether mahadraṇam denotes a literal battle or metaphorical carnage is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: She will make a great battle as far as the Karatoyā river.
